description: Get a condensed overview of the workspace board: panel counts, projects, velocity, users, and ticket summaries for the current and backlog panels unless others are named. Release, milestone and deadline markers are included, and counted. Use this to orient yourself before drilling into specific tickets.

panels.description: Comma-separated panel names to include ticket details for (default "current,backlog"): icebox, backlog, current, done, which the board shows as Icebox, Backlog, Current and Done. Panels not listed return only count/points.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID, as list_workspaces gives it. Defaults to the one workspace this connection reaches; required when it reaches several.

name: get_workspace_summary
title: Workspace summary
